items.says: Units and methods of dimensioning and tolerancing follow AS 1100.101.
Use a general tolerance note so size and geometry of every feature is controlled. App A is guidance; the designer decides the values.
items.check: auto, advisory: general tolerance note present

items.says: Line type and thickness follow AS 1100.101.
Scales comply with AS 1100.101. Keep different scales on one sheet to a minimum and indicate every scale clearly.
items.check: auto, advisory: more than one scale on a sheet; scale not stated. N.T.S. masters need Ross's ruling

items.says: Surface texture symbol: sloping lines at 60 degrees to the horizontal; size tied to character height h (ratios 1.4h, 2h, 2.8h in the figure).
items.check: manual for now (symbol is a block); geometry check is a later task

items.says: Machining mandatory: basic symbol with a bar. Removal not permitted: basic symbol with a circle.
Ra is chosen from the preferred series and shown in micrometres.
items.check: auto: every Ra value in text is in the series

items.says: A single Ra value is the maximum permitted. With two values, the maximum is placed above the minimum.
Production process in plain language above the symbol extension. Ra applies after plating or chemical treatment unless stated.
Where one texture applies to many surfaces, a defined substitute symbol may be used, placed near a view, the title block or the general notes. Exceptions are marked on their surfaces.
Welding symbols are given in AS 1101.3.
Centre hole symbols per Fig 5.1; designation refers to AS 1913, drill type A, B or R, then d and D separated by a slash. No symbol if the centre hole may remain on the finished part.
items.check: manual; needs AS 1913 for the sizes

items.clause: AS 1100.201 App A cl A2, A3, Tables A1 to A7
items.says: General note: linear accuracy grade f, m, c or v; angular tolerance; geometry grade H, K or L. Perpendicularity is taken from the longer side.
items.check: auto, advisory: note present. Value tables not encoded until the licence position is settled

items.says: Use 'Perpendicularity' (not 'Squareness') and 'Circularity' (not 'Roundness') as tolerance characteristic names.
No asterisks on the circular runout and total runout symbols.
Corrected figure on interpretation of linear dimensions: a general tolerance note and limit readings (for example 500 with plus or minus 5).
Corrected figure: single datum established by two features.
Simplified representation of pipelines, springs, gears, splines, rolling bearings, seals and knurling.
